scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy
scripts.android:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:run: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
